## Grok Imagine 2.0 API

Grok Imagine 2.0 is an image generation and image editing model by xAI, available on the Venice API as `grok-imagine-image-2-0`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Grok Imagine 2.0 is the second generation of xAI's Grok Imagine image model, generating images at 1K or 2K from text, with low and medium quality settings. It pairs with Grok Imagine 2.0 Edit for changing existing images.

### Grok Imagine 2.0 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grok-imagine-image-2-0` | Generate | Private | $0.07 / image |
| `grok-imagine-image-2-0-edit` | Edit | Private | $0.07 / edit |

Prices by `quality` for `grok-imagine-image-2-0`, `medium` when left out:

| Quality | 1K | 2K |
|---|---|---|
| low | $0.05 | $0.07 |
| medium | $0.07 | $0.10 |

### Grok Imagine 2.0 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | xAI |
| Released | Aug 11, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 2:1, 19.5:9, 20:9, 21:9, 5:2, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 1:2, 9:19.5, 9:20 |
| Prompt limit | 7,500 characters |

### How to use the Grok Imagine 2.0 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "grok-imagine-image-2-0"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "grok-imagine-image-2-0",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
